patch_description: This redesign uses an input-derived multi-start archive followed by adaptive ruin-and-refill search. It builds several C4-free scaffolds from differently ordered subsets of the supplied edges, greedily saturates them using a future-loss heuristic, and stores distinct elite states. It then removes obstruction-heavy edges from elite candidates and refills them while temporarily forbidding immediate restoration of deleted edges. Every insertion is locally checked, and retained candidates are explicitly verified with the common-neighbor invariant.
